title: Listening Drill — School parcel collections — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: School parcel collections — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on school parcel collections. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Friday. The group will now meet on Saturday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the shop gate; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is claim ticket. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow fifteen minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check parcel size before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed dispatch note so we can offer feedback.
